ai.title: Disable comment preservation in fastRewrite
ai.summary: Removed `preserveCommentsInEditSnippet` call from `fastRewrite` in `backend/src/fast-rewrite.ts`. The edit snippet now passes directly to `promptRelaceAI` without an intermediate LLM step to restore comments. This eliminates the `editSnippetWithComments` variable and associated timing metrics (`commentPreservationDuration`).

eli5.text: The assistant no longer takes an extra step to save and reinsert comments when applying your code edits. Edits are now sent directly for processing instead of first being scanned for comments and then rebuilt with them, which speeds up this part of the workflow slightly. You may notice that edits are applied faster, but any comments that were present in your original code might be missing from the result since they are no longer being preserved during this internal step.

ai.title: Clarify prompt instructions on comments and ambiguity
ai.summary: Updated `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` to tighten agent behavior. Clarifying questions now trigger only when interpretations lead to very different outcomes. Instructions explicitly require preserving original user comments line-for-line during `write_file` operations.

eli5.text: The assistant now asks follow-up questions only when a request could clearly be interpreted in very different ways, instead of asking whenever an interpretation is merely possible. It also now keeps your original comments in a file exactly as you wrote them, line by line, when saving changes, rather than paraphrasing or dropping them. These adjustments are live in the internal system that guides how the assistant responds to and edits your files.
